text:
Anika: Quick ask — final creative for X/LinkedIn push for the webinar next Tue. Need 3 variants: hero image + copy, 2 carousel frames, 1 short gif. Who can hand off final assets by EOD Friday? Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Axyz

Ben: Uploading hero + 2 carousels now. Can we confirm headline? Last time the benchmark narrative used specific numbers, want to avoid hard claims. Suggest: 'Make LLM inference predictable & affordable.'

Diego: I can write 3 caption variations for A/B. Will do: CTA 1 = 'Register', CTA 2 = 'Watch demo', CTA 3 = 'Read benchmark'. Which is primary?

Riya: Primary = Register. Secondary = Read benchmark (link to benchmark page). Also routing: leads from webinar sign-ups should tag 'webinar-APR' and route to Sam in SDR queue. @Sam fyi.

Sam: Got it. I'll prep a playbook: tag -> CSV -> HubSpot list. Please add 'company_size' & 'region' to form.

ContentOpsBot: Reminder: posting windows — X: Tue 10:30am PT / LinkedIn: Tue 11:00am PT. Use buffer job #webinar-3612.

Ben: Uploaded assets: hero_v3.png, carousel_1.png, carousel_2.png, gif_tease.mp4 — added design notes in drive.

Anika: Thanks. Diego — can you post the 3 caption options in this thread? Need to pick by Fri 2pm.

Diego: Caption A: 'Inference you can rely on — join our webinar to see how teams cut latency & cost.' Caption B: 'Where model capability meets production reliability. Webinar — register.' Caption C: 'Want predictable LLM performance? We'll show how.'

Riya: A is good but tweak to remove 'cut latency & cost' — maybe 'improve latency and cost' to sound less like a guarantee.

Diego: Updated: Caption A2: 'Inference you can rely on — join our webinar to see how teams improve latency and cost.'

Anika: :thumbsup: locking A2. Ben upload final hero with headline change? (same filename OK)

Ben: Done — hero_final_v4.png now in drive.

Anika: Diego, once you drop captions I'll schedule. Also need 2 follow-up engagement posts: Day 1 reminder + Day 3 replay link. Keep them punchy.

Diego: Adding those lines below: Reminder: 'Starts today at 10am PT — last seats' Replay: 'Missed it? Watch the replay: https://redwood.ai/replay'

Sam: For routing: please add hidden field 'lead_source=webinar_social' in the signup form. Can someone add to the form config? @Riya

Riya: I'll update form and ping Product to add hidden field. Also pushing benchmark narrative link: https://redwood.ai/benchmarks/inference-economics — include as 'Read our benchmark' in the secondary caption.

Anika: Perfect. Last ask: can someone batch-schedule the posts? We use Buffer; here's a quick command for the scheduler via CLI:

ContentOpsBot: ```
buffer schedule --profile redwood-x --file hero_final_v4.png --caption "Inference you can rely on — join our webinar to see how teams improve latency and cost. Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar" --time "2026-04-14T10:30:00-07:00"
```

Diego: I can run that after final check. Will also enable thread replies monitoring — set up a daily digest with mentions to #sales for hot leads.

ContentOpsBot: Automated note: Campaign tag 'webinar_apr_2026' created. Tracked UTM: utm_source=social&utm_campaign=webinar_apr_2026

Anika: Thanks team. Final timeline: assets in drive (Ben) by EOD Fri, copy locked (Diego) by Fri 2pm, form updated (Riya) by Mon, scheduler runs Mon noon PT. Anything else?

Ben: Gif size OK for X? I compressed to 3MB.

Sam: Got the tag mapping. I'll monitor HubSpot & ping sales for MQLs.

Riya: :sparkles: done
